ngwe25.title: Libra: how you love in winter
ngwe25.caption: Libra, you love by making everything lovely: the lights, the mugs, the whole room. It's sweet. Just remember the person came for you, not the decor. You are the cozy part.

ngwe26.title: Libra: the holiday blind spot
ngwe26.caption: Three invites, one Saturday, three yeses. Saying no to a party isn't letting anyone down, it's saving a yes for yourself. One plan is plenty this month.

ngwe27.title: Libra: the gift you secretly want
ngwe27.caption: You choose for everyone all year. The kindest gift for a Libra is someone who says "I picked the place, just show up." Send this to the person who should.

ngwe28.title: Libra: one word for the new year
ngwe28.caption: Libra, your word for next year is ask. Ask for the table you want and the time you need, then give people the chance to say yes. You might be surprised.

ngwe29.title: Scorpio: how you love in winter
ngwe29.caption: Scorpio, you remember the small things: their colour, their oat milk, their cold ears. That's a quiet kind of devotion. Let them hear the big thing out loud too.

ngwe30.title: Scorpio: the holiday blind spot
ngwe30.caption: Keeping a list of who didn't text back over the holidays? It only gets longer. Tell people you missed them, then let the rest go. Close the ledger.

ngwe31.title: Scorpio: the gift that means the most
ngwe31.caption: Scorpio doesn't care about the bow. What lands is trust, a small sign that says you're in. Save this for whoever's shopping for a Scorpio this year.

ngwe32.title: Scorpio: one word for the new year
ngwe32.caption: Scorpio, your word for next year is soften. Not weaker, warmer. Letting people closer doesn't cost you your strength. Soft is still strong.

ngwe33.title: Sagittarius: how you love in winter
ngwe33.caption: Sagittarius loves by making people laugh: the snowman, the voices, the bit. Keep the jokes, and leave a quiet moment after them for the real thing.

ngwe34.title: Sagittarius: the holiday blind spot
ngwe34.caption: Honesty is one of your best traits, Sagittarius. At the holiday table, pair it with a thank you. The truth lands softer when kindness goes first.

ngwe35.title: Sagittarius: the gift that means the most
ngwe35.caption: Sagittarius doesn't want more stuff. A hand-drawn map for a walk where they pick the turns? That's the gift. An experience beats anything in a box.

ngwe36.title: Sagittarius: one word for the new year
ngwe36.caption: Sagittarius, your word for next year is slow. Slow walks, slow mornings, a slow "I like you." Slowing down isn't standing still.

ngwe37.title: Capricorn: how you love in winter
ngwe37.caption: Capricorn loves by showing up early: the shovelled path, the cocoa on the step. It's beautiful. Love goes both ways though, so let them help you too.

ngwe38.title: Capricorn: the holiday blind spot
ngwe38.caption: Bringing work to the party is very Capricorn. The emails will still be there tomorrow, and this night won't come back. You're allowed to just be here.

ngwe39.title: Capricorn: the gift that means the most
ngwe39.caption: Capricorn mentions a goal once and moves on. The gift that gets them? Proof someone was listening. Write down what they said they wanted.
